pattern: SELECT .+ AS total_[A-Za-z0-9]+ FROM matches JOIN players ON T1\.winner\_id = T2\.player\_id (?:JOIN rankings AS T3 ON T2\.player\_id = T3\.player\_id)? GROUP BY T1\.winner\_name ORDER BY SUM\(T2\.ranking\_points\) DESC LIMIT 1
correction: Replace the aggregation function with COUNT, and ensure that the JOIN conditions filter data specifically related to the matches won by each player.

metadata.description: This rule detects queries that incorrectly aggregate ranking points instead of counting the number of matches won.
